{{Top|leg}}
The '''Hall of Ministers''' was one of the government buildings on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Samaria/Legends|Samaria]]. Located with the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sath]], the main atrium was over fifty stories tall. Emulating the false bay around Sath, the roof was tiled with blue stones. Inside on the upper floor was a private landing area for legislators. The building was expected to host [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the years following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
